messages.subject: LCPO for semi-continuous models
parts:
Hi,

I am running semi-continous models applied to some ecological issues. According to Elias SPDE tutorial we have to take care on the DIC when computing for the joint models. In this sense, we have to compute de sum of the local DIC for both responses (z and y). 
Besides the DIC for the goodness-of-fit, I want to compute the LCPO as a predictive power measure for each tested model. 
Do I have to calculate separately the LCPOs for each response variable too?


Best regards,

Marie
